logs.description: Creating the user drop downmenu interface, added the the login button & svelte +page.server for cookie deletion; Updated the "remember me" field on the login page to actually affect cookie session expire time (checked = 30 days, unchecked = current session)
logs.reflection: I wasted a bit of time on the backend for a logout route/controller function to delete the cookie. I was unable to delete the cookie via backend because svelte "owns" the frontend cookie because of how I set it in the +page.server.ts, so backend isn't is only used for creating the token, not for removing it.
